items.headline: Google, Meta and TikTok Sue California Over Gavin Newsom's Law Restricting Addictive Social Media Features for Children
items.summary: Google, Meta and TikTok sue California to block a new law targeting addictive social media features and protecting children online.

items.headline: $3 Trillion Wiped Out, But This Strategist Says AI's Biggest Problem Isn't Demand: 'Compute Will Become More Scarce'
items.summary: James Thorne said the AI selloff, which erased about $3 trillion from U.S. stocks, reflects heavy leverage and weak sentiment.

items.headline: Peter Schiff Says Bitcoin's 'Final Pin' Has Arrived as AI Bubble Deflates: 'Sell Now Before the Air Comes Gushing Out'
items.summary: Economist Peter Schiff said on Thursday that investors are overlooking Bitcoin while focusing too heavily on a "deflating AI bubble."

items.headline: Trump Governed 'Almost Entirely Without Congress,' Justin Wolfers Says: 'The Real Question' Is Who Will Stop Him
items.summary: Economist Justin Wolfers said the midterms sent a message on the economy and will test if Congress will stop Trump, who governs without it.

items.headline: Robotaxis Aren't Killing Lyft's Business: CEO Says Company Is Growing in AV Markets, Details Waymo Partnership
items.summary: Lyft says robotaxis aren't hurting growth, focusing on Waymo and Baidu partnerships while expanding autonomous fleets.

items.headline: Asian Stocks Tumble After $3 Trillion US Wipeout as SK hynix Leads KOSPI Rout — Mohamed El-Erian Says 'When the Nasdaq Sneezes...'
items.summary: Asian chipmakers sank Friday as the AI selloff that erased $3 trillion from U.S. stocks spread, on fears Democrats could slow AI buildout.

items.headline: Stock Market: Will S&P 500 Open Up or Down Today?
items.summary: Will the S&P 500 open higher? Polymarket odds hit 62% as Wall Street eyes jobs data and a tech rebound.

items.headline: Peter Schiff Sees More Pain Ahead After $3 Trillion Wipeout, While Gary Black Spots a Tech Buying Opportunity: 'The Market Has Reset'
items.summary: Peter Schiff warned of further losses after a $3 trillion market rout, while Gary Black saw a buying opportunity in tech stocks.

items.headline: Nvidia Stock Loses $1.39 Trillion Since October Peak — Jim Cramer Says NVDA Can 'Buy and Reload'
items.summary: Nvidia lost nearly $450 billion in market value Thursday, and CNBC’s Jim Cramer said the AI darling should buy its own stock.

items.headline: Trump Blames 'Dumocrats' as Stock Market Suffers $3 Trillion Rout After Democrats Win Congress: 'Your 401(k)s Have Dropped'

items.headline: Needham Maintains Buy Rating and Raises Price Target for Vertex Pharmaceuticals
items.summary: Needham has reaffirmed its 'Buy' rating on Vertex Pharmaceuticals and increased its price target for the company's stock.

items.headline: Microsoft Adjusts AI Infrastructure Strategy and Capital Expenditure Outlook
items.summary: Microsoft has reduced its 2026 capital expenditure projection to $170 billion from $175 billion and is becoming more selective with data center capacity commitments.

items.headline: BlackRock Discloses Investment Discretion Over SEGRO Shares

items.summary: NVIDIA is reportedly developing a strategy to repurpose existing telecommunications infrastructure into small-scale AI data centers to accelerate chip deployment and bypass construction hurdles.

items.headline: Chip Stocks Just Had Their Worst Day Since 2020: 28 of 30 Biggest Names Are in a Bear Market
